name: us9-hook-registration
description: The config command registers the six after_* lifecycle hooks idempotently in .specify/extensions.yml as the second of its three effects (FR-045, FR-054). The post-run workdir snapshot must carry a byte-identical extensions.yml on both ports, and the --json summary's effects.hooks section must match (NFR-1). Idempotency and disabled-hook preservation are asserted directly in tests/bash/hooks/test_register_hooks.bats; this golden scenario proves the config-command wiring writes identically end-to-end.
